Key Talking Points
●  ReadyCare Signature is Malaysia's first USDA Bio-Based certified brand, offering eco-friendly
   and skin-friendly cleaning solutions.
●  The campaign targets 20 Key Opinion Consumers (KOCs) to test and review three key
   products: Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner, Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent, and Biobased
   Dishwashing Liquid.
●  Each product is tailored for specific audience groups: women with skin allergies, parents of
   children with sensitive skin, and general households seeking chemical-free solutions.
●  The campaign leverages authentic reviews and user-generated content (UGC) from KOCs to
   build trust and brand confidence among potential customers.
●  ReadyCare's products are manufactured and certified by Malaysia Halal Certification issued
   under Department of Islamic Development Malaysia (JAKIM)
●  The initiative aims to collect video testimonials from KOCs and their followers, enhancing
   credibility and engagement.
●  The campaign aligns with ReadyCare's mission to promote a healthier planet through bio-
   based, renewable cleaning solutions.                                                      2

---
Best Practices For KOC Content Creator in TikTok
1.  Highlight Eco-Friendly Benefits
●   Emphasize the USDA-certified bio-based and vegan-friendly features of ReadyCare Signature products. KOCs should
    showcase how these products contribute to a sustainable lifestyle appealing to environmentally conscious consumers in
    Malaysia.
1.  Showcase Product Versatility
●   Demonstrate the multiple uses of ReadyCare products such as the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner for various surfaces or
    the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent for delicate fabrics. This helps potential buyers see the value in one product.
1.  Engage with Personal Stories
●   KOCs should share personal experiences or testimonials about using ReadyCare products such as how the Biobased
    Dishwashing Liquid made their dishes sparkle or how the Baby Laundry Detergent is gentle on their child's skin.
1.  Leverage TikTok Trends
●   Incorporate trending sounds challenges or hashtags on TikTok to increase visibility. For example create a 'cleaning hack'
    video using the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner to align with popular content themes.
1.  Use Before-and-After Visuals
●   Show the effectiveness of ReadyCare products through before-and-after clips. For instance compare dirty dishes cleaned
    with the Biobased Dishwashing Liquid or stained clothes washed with the Baby Laundry Detergent.
1.  Encourage User Participation
●   Invite followers to try ReadyCare products and share their experiences. KOCs can run a giveaway or challenge where
    participants post their own reviews or cleaning results using a branded hashtag.
1.  Focus on Safety and Gentleness
●   Highlight the hypoallergenic and skin-friendly properties of ReadyCare products especially for baby care items. KOCs can
    reassure parents about the absence of harsh chemicals in the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent.
1.  Include Clear Call-to-Actions
●   End videos with a strong CTA such as 'Swipe up to shop now' or 'Comment below for a chance to win a free trial pack.' This  6
    drives engagement and conversions for the giveaway campaign.
---
  Post-collaboration
  Recommendations
1.  Encourage KOCs to tag ReadyCare Signature in their TikTok
●   Ensure KOCs include @ReadyCareSignature in their captions and video descriptions to link back to the
    brand's TikTok account. This practice increases brand visibility and allows the KOC's audience to easily
    discover ReadyCare Signature's TikTok profile.
1.  Utilize trending and relevant hashtags
●   Collaborate with KOCs to incorporate trending and niche-specific hashtags like #EcoFriendlyCleaning
    and #BioBasedProducts in their posts.Hashtags enhance discoverability and attract a broader audience
    interested in sustainable cleaning solutions.
1.  Cross-promote collaborations on other platforms
●   Share snippets or behind-the-scenes content of the KOC collaboration on Instagram Facebook or
    YouTube linking back to the TikTok post. Cross-promotion maximizes reach and engages audiences
    across multiple social media platforms.
1.  Analyze post-collaboration performance metrics
●   Track engagement metrics such as views likes shares and comments to evaluate the success of the
    KOC collaboration. Data-driven insights help refine future influencer marketing strategies and improve
    ROI.

Best Practices For KOC Content Creator in TikTok
1.  Highlight Eco-Friendly Benefits
●   Emphasize the USDA-certified bio-based and vegan-friendly features of ReadyCare Signature products. KOCs should
    showcase how these products contribute to a sustainable lifestyle appealing to environmentally conscious consumers in
    Malaysia.
1.  Showcase Product Versatility
●   Demonstrate the multiple uses of ReadyCare products such as the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner for various surfaces or
    the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent for delicate fabrics. This helps potential buyers see the value in one product.
1.  Engage with Personal Stories
●   KOCs should share personal experiences or testimonials about using ReadyCare products such as how the Biobased
    Dishwashing Liquid made their dishes sparkle or how the Baby Laundry Detergent is gentle on their child's skin.
1.  Leverage TikTok Trends
●   Incorporate trending sounds challenges or hashtags on TikTok to increase visibility. For example create a 'cleaning hack'
    video using the Biobased Multipurpose Cleaner to align with popular content themes.
1.  Use Before-and-After Visuals
●   Show the effectiveness of ReadyCare products through before-and-after clips. For instance compare dirty dishes cleaned
    with the Biobased Dishwashing Liquid or stained clothes washed with the Baby Laundry Detergent.
1.  Encourage User Participation
●   Invite followers to try ReadyCare products and share their experiences. KOCs can run a giveaway or challenge where
    participants post their own reviews or cleaning results using a branded hashtag.
1.  Focus on Safety and Gentleness
●   Highlight the hypoallergenic and skin-friendly properties of ReadyCare products especially for baby care items. KOCs can
    reassure parents about the absence of harsh chemicals in the Biobased Baby Laundry Detergent.
1.  Include Clear Call-to-Actions
●   End videos with a strong CTA such as 'Swipe up to shop now' or 'Comment below for a chance to win a free trial pack.' This  6
    drives engagement and conversions for the giveaway campaign.
